column1: # employers.tsv -- GENERATED. Do not hand-edit; use manual.tsv instead.
# The generator rewrites this file wholesale, so any correction made here is
# reverted by the next refresh. Corrections belong in manual.tsv, which is
# overlaid on top of this file at load time and which the generator never writes.
# Only unambiguous matches (match_confidence=high) are written here. Everything
# weaker lands in candidates.tsv for a human to review and promote by hand. An
# unmatched company is a correct and expected answer: most companies this
# project crawls are private and SEC EDGAR does not know they exist.
# THIS FILE HAS NO ROWS YET. No generator run against the live sources has
# happened: it needs outbound network access, which only GitHub Actions has.
# Rows will not be invented to make the file look populated -- a fabricated CIK
# or headcount is indistinguishable from a real one once it is in the table.
#   public     true, false, or empty for "nobody has established this"
#   employees  headcount at `retrieved`, empty when unknown
#   retrieved  YYYY-MM-DD the upstream facts were fetched
